name: Alert
description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative, and swap Initiative with one willing ally right after you roll.
source_note: Acquisition record only. The Initiative rules belong to CXM-05.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the chosen class's spell list.
source: SRD 5.2.1 p.87 Origin Feats: Magic Initiate
source_note: Acquisition record only. The spell choices, casting ability and free casting belong to CXM-60.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, roll its damage dice twice and use either roll.
source: SRD 5.2.1 p.87 Origin Feats: Savage Attacker
source_note: Acquisition record only. The damage roll rule belongs to CXM-06.
